maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost row consists of four distinct spots following a slightly arched trajectory that remains sub-parallel to the denser row below, with the inter-spot distance increasing toward the posterior margin.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The visible lateral aspect of the rhinarium displays approximately 95-100% melanin saturation with no visible depigmented or pink areas.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: The profile exhibits a continuous contour with a shallow concave depression (stop) at the nasal bridge, forming an obtuse angle of approximately 160 degrees between the frontal plane and the nasal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigmentation on the superior-posterior edge of the ear pinna and a concentrated dark teardrop marking at the posterior canthus of the eye.
